name: Productivity Quick Tips
description: Fast-paced, high-value tip format — 3 actionable tips in 60 seconds. Best for productivity, self-improvement, and career growth content. Hook-driven opener, punchy tips, memorable closer.
voice_style: sharp, energetic, authoritative — like a confident mentor who respects your time; no filler words
music_mood: upbeat lo-fi, positive electronic, corporate motivational

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: You're losing 2 hours every day without knowing it. Here are 3 fixes that take 5 minutes each.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person at desk looking stressed, clock time-lapse showing hours disappearing, phone screen glowing, overwhelmed expression close-up
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow push-in from medium shot to tight face close-up on stressed expression
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: overhead fluorescent mixed with monitor light, slightly warm skin tones, slight vignette on edges
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Establish chaos then pivot to calm; clock time-lapse should show dramatic hour drain effect

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: In the next 60 seconds I'm giving you 3 productivity tricks that actually work — save this before you forget.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Text overlay '3 TIPS IN 60 SECONDS', person pointing at camera, countdown timer graphic, confident expression
scene_sequence.camera_movement: static medium close-up, confident direct address, subtle confident head tilt
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: clean key light from above-right, minimal shadows, bright and energetic feel, slight warm tint
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Direct address energy — eye contact with camera is critical; clean white background or professional bokeh

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Tip one: Time-block your hardest task for the first 90 minutes of your day. No meetings, no email. Your brain is sharpest then.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Calendar blocking visualization, early morning desk setup, brain icon with lightning bolt, person in focused work mode, phone on silent
scene_sequence.camera_movement: cut from calendar graphic to desk establishing shot to face close-up, each lasting ~3 seconds
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: natural window light on desk (side key), screen light fill, clean sharp focus throughout
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Clean graphic-to-real hybrid cuts; calendar graphic should have bold typography matching brand colors

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Tip two: Use the 2-minute rule. If something takes less than 2 minutes — do it now. Don't add it to a list.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Small tasks being crossed off instantly, email inbox going to zero, person responding quickly, clock showing fast-forward motion
scene_sequence.camera_movement: quick cuts between task completions, handheld energy, medium-to-close-up transitions
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: energetic bright lighting throughout, slightly cool white light, fast-paced feel
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Speed and energy — fast cuts convey momentum; screen recording inserts of inbox-to-zero create satisfying visual

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Tip three: End every day with a 3-item tomorrow list. Not 10. Not 5. Three. The night before.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Notebook closing with 3 items visible, person getting up from desk satisfied, peaceful evening scene, pen writing three bullet points
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow cinematic pan across notebook to close-up on three bullet items, then slow pull-out as person closes notebook
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm evening ambient light, desk lamp warm glow, cooler blue evening through window for depth
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Contrast the quick earlier tips with calm closing energy; notebook detail shots are satisfying and shareable

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Time-block, 2-minute rule, tomorrow list. Three things. Try it tomorrow.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: All three tips shown as icons on screen simultaneously, person nodding, clean white background, text callouts
scene_sequence.camera_movement: static medium close-up with graphic overlay, confident nod
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: clean bright key light, minimal shadows, professional product-shot quality
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Clean summary graphic is key — bold icons, brand colors, scannable at a glance

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Follow for more productivity hacks. Drop a comment — what's your biggest time-waster right now?
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person pointing at follow button, comment box appearing, smiling directly at camera, subscribe icon pulsing
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up, slight push-in on CTA moment, warm smile
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: bright warm key light, welcoming energy, slight lens flare on edges
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Warm friendly energy; CTA should feel like a genuine invitation, not a sales pitch
